title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Agreement — Upfront Fee Payment Deadline and Lock Dates
content:
These terms of the Builder Extended Rate Lock govern when the upfront fee must be paid, how it is paid, and how the lock expiration date is set.

## 1. Upfront fee amount (retired clause)

> The upfront lock fee is the greater of the upfront fee percent of the loan amount (rounded half up to the cent) and the minimum upfront fee, and is zero where the upfront fee percent is zero.

This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the upfront lock fee.

## 2. Payment method

The upfront fee is paid by a method in the term's accepted payment methods.

## 3. Payment deadline

**Clause.** The upfront fee must be paid within the term's fee due business days after the lock request date. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Calloway holidays, and counting starts the next business day after the request date.

- The clock starts from the lock request date shown on the lock record; that date is the authority.
- The request date itself is not counted; the first business day after it is business day one.
- A payment on the last business day counted is within the deadline.
- A request whose fee is not paid in time is not confirmed and must be requested again at the then-current par rate.

| Fee posted | Within the deadline |
|---|---|
| on any business day from day one through the last counted business day | Yes |
| on the business day after the last counted business day, or later | No — the request is not confirmed and must be requested again at the then-current par rate |

Hypothetical: with a deadline of 3 business days, a request made on a business day is counted from the next business day; a fee posted on the third business day counted is in time, and a fee posted on the fourth is not. A Saturday, a Sunday or a Calloway holiday between them is skipped and does not count.

## 4. Locked rate (retired clause)

> The locked rate is the par rate plus the term's rate premium, plus the extra rate premium on a jumbo loan, less the government program premium reduction on fha, va or usda, never below the par rate.

This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the locked rate.

## 5. Lock expiration date

The lock expiration date is the lock date plus the term's lock term days. Where the term's lock runs to the next business day and that day is a Saturday, Sunday or Calloway holiday, the lock runs through the next business day.

Hypothetical: a lock date plus the term's days lands on a Sunday; the lock runs through the following Monday, or through the Tuesday if that Monday is a Calloway holiday.

superseded_clauses: The upfront lock fee is the greater of upfront_fee_pct percent of the loan amount (rounded half up to the cent) and upfront_fee_min_usd, and is zero where upfront_fee_pct is zero
The locked rate is the par rate plus rate_premium_pct, plus jumbo_extra_rate_premium_pct on a jumbo loan, less government_program_premium_discount_pct on fha, va or usda, never below the par rate.
